key_insight: LEAP combines a perovskite-focused LLM with active learning to rank precursor additives more intelligently than trial-and-error screening.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers a practical, low-data pipeline for accelerating additive discovery and improving perovskite solar cell performance with fewer experiments.
method: Trains a domain-specialized LLM on perovskite additive literature to extract mechanism-relevant knowledge.
Represents candidate molecules with interpretable descriptors and feeds them into Bayesian optimization.
Uses expert-in-the-loop feasibility review to iteratively prioritize additives across screening rounds.
evidence_signal: On unseen literature, the specialized model outperformed general-purpose models in mechanism-consistent reasoning, and proof-of-concept experiments yielded later-round average PCEs of 20.13% and 20.87% versus 19.25% for control, with a champion PCE of 21.32%.
watch_item: Results are promising but preliminary, and the approach depends on high-quality literature knowledge plus expert review, which may limit scalability and transferability.
paper_title: LEAP: A closed-loop framework for perovskite precursor additive discovery
